stories.title: Researchers Used a Public OpenAI Model to Build a $250,000 Chrome Full-Chain Exploit in Six Days
stories.description: XBOW built an AI-assisted, three-bug Chrome exploit chain in six days that enabled Windows code execution; Google has fixed all three bugs.

stories.title: Hirudo Android Trojan Uses Patched Banking Apps to Bypass Their Built-In Security Checks
stories.description: Hirudo targets eight Indonesian banking apps with patched replacements that can bypass signature, accessibility, and integrity checks.

stories.title: An AI Agent Found a Critical OTP Bypass in Production. The Attack Was the Easy Part.
stories.description: Reflectiz's AI agent bypassed an insurer's live login by directing a one-time code to its own inbox during an authorized assessment.

stories.title: US Arrests Two in Crackdown on North Korean IT Worker Laptop Farms
stories.description: Investigators stormed 40 locations in Texas and seized 187 laptops used by North Korean IT workers to hide their location.

stories.title: VirusTotal Integrates Threat Intelligence With ChatGPT for Malware Analysis
stories.description: VirusTotal can now bring threat intelligence into ChatGPT through VirusTotal AI (VTAI), allowing users to investigate suspicious files, URLs, domains and IP addresses within a conversation.

stories.title: Google Awarded $250,000 Bounty for a Full-chain Chrome Exploit Found Using GPT-5.6
stories.description: Security researchers earned a $250,000 reward from Google after building a full-chain Chrome exploit with AI agents. The XBOW team says the work took six days and about $40,000 in computing costs, using OpenAI’s publicly available GPT-5.6 Sol model. Google…

stories.title: Windows SmartScreen Vulnerability Enables Privilege Escalation Attacks
stories.description: Microsoft fixed a high-severity Windows SmartScreen use-after-free flaw that allows local privilege escalation.

stories.title: Coruna and DarkSword Exploit Kits Can Fully Compromise iPhones From a Single Web Visit
stories.description: Coruna and DarkSword exploit outdated iPhones through malicious websites, chaining iOS flaws to steal data without app installation.

stories.title: AI-Found Linux Kernel Flaw Gives Local Users Root, and Can Break a Guest Out to the Host
stories.description: Linux's Vghost flaw lets users with vhost device access gain root and, in specific VM setups, lets guests hijack host QEMU.

stories.title: Chrome, Firefox Updates Patch 114 Flaws as Mozilla Unveils Firefox Enterprise
stories.description: Mozilla has introduced Firefox Enterprise for organizations with strict compliance, governance, and security requirements.

stories.title: Citrix, Fortinet, Ivanti Patch 29 Vulnerabilities Across Their Products
stories.description: Critical-severity flaws could lead to authentication bypass, code execution, and sensitive authentication information leaks.

stories.title: Microsoft Patches Record 1,413 Vulnerabilities, Including Exploited Windows Zero-Day
stories.description: The most important is CVE-2026-96951, a security feature bypass flaw in Windows that has been exploited in the wild.

stories.description: Years ago I wrote diary entries about VBA code stored inside AutoCAD drawing files (.dwg).
